gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-mooli: Wiry and a bit stubborn, Bellota Text draws every curve with one unvarying line, while Mooli's rounded sans letters stay open and easy at small sizes. Long paragraphs would move along smoothly.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-murecho: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota Text has no thick-and-thin modulation at all, just a flat, unshaded line. And Murecho sans follows with s curves that open wide at both ends, giving the text a modern, clean feel.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-nanum-gothic: Wire-bent curves, bold presence. Bellota Text keeps its s from ever thinning at the spine, so it earns its place at large sizes and in short, punchy lines, while Nanum Gothic quietly handles the rest with wide channels into each counter.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-national-park: Bellota Text leads with open c, e, and s shapes and no calligraphic shading, so it looks commanding and distinctive. National Park follows in plain sans, drawn with a pen that never changes pressure or angle, rounded and clearly open on one side.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-niramit: Bold, open, and unshaded, Bellota Text has no brush-style pressure swell anywhere in its lettering. But Niramit, in plain sans, is the one built to carry text, its gaping curves staying clean and professional.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-canadia: Bellota Text draws its open c, e, and s with a constant-width pen line, giving headings a commanding, distinctive look. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal does the quieter work, keeping every curve end open so sans-serif text stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Noto Sans Cypriot lets its e open up rather than close its eye, which makes the plain sans body approachable and clean. Bellota Text brings the commanding contrast.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-cypro-m: Flat, stencil-like and confident. Bellota Text is at its best where its open, unshaded letters can stand out, while Noto Sans Cypro Minoan, a sans-serif with terminals cut back to leave a big gap, handles the everyday reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-: Zero stress in any curve, and plenty of attitude. Bellota Text is made to command attention up top, whereas Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya, a sans with a visibly gaping c, keeps things approachable below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Approachable from the start, Noto Sans Hatran gives its e a wide throat like a funnel, while Bellota Text draws strokes with the steadiness of a drawn string. Extended reading in the sans-serif feels open and unhurried.
